notes.title: Update to version 1.1
notes.content:
We are proud to announce the first update of Stop it - Driving Simulation.

This update is adding an initial support of steering wheels with firstly a full compatibility for Thrustmaster devices. Other may come in the future if requested.

It also adds a few keyboard shortcuts requested by the community: 

"R" : Reset the current level with the same settings
"Esc" : Quit the game

Finally some minor bug were fixed.
